title: helenium grandiflorum
intro: Helenium grandiflorum, commonly known as Sneezeweed, is a flowering plant species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sneezeweed include expectorant and antitussive effects, making it a potential natural remedy for coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Helenium grandiflorum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
